data_integrity.no_future_rows_note: ledger rows are a subset of this file's dates; verified by trade-date membership

lookahead_audit.method: full pipeline rebuilt from data truncated at each signal day; signal must be identical from signal-day-close information alone

split_boundary_audit.rule: historical: bucket by ENTRY date; train <= 2019-11-20 < validation <= 2023-04-23 < final; exit dates never re-bucket a trade (Golden Reference semantics)
split_boundary_audit.straddle_note: trades whose exit falls in a later period remain in their entry-date bucket (historical convention); no information transfers backward because bucketing is by entry date only
